snippet.title: Error 2351 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Error 2351 launches April 28th on Steam.
➡️https://store.steampowered.com/app/4049970/Error_2351/

What is it about?❔ 
Following various types of strange disturbances reported near Ridgecourt Forest, a young policeman named Silas tries to uncover the hidden mystery. For many years, noone, nor the police or the state, have ever tried to enter the area. But entering the asylum won't be as easy as he thought. On his investigative journey, Silas must solve different kinds of puzzles and escape the mayhem.

Asylum? 👻 
You heard right. The popular asylum, which belongs to a part of Ridgecourt Forest still counts as one of the most dangerous places in the country. Not only missing people, but unidentified dead bodies have also been found near the building, leaving the residents in a shock. Police say that all of this is part of Jake Kron's experiments. Desperate and homeless persons get manipulated and abused by him, only to serve as "test objects". He keeps them in his basement, which served as a bunker and was used to store different types of weapons and armour in the second world war. The outline of this place remains unknown as no entry or exit has been found and a lot of infrastructure has been destroyed since then.

When? ⏲️ 
The scenery takes place in 1986. At this time, Ridgecourt's police was understaffed due to ongoing cases of missing officers and killed people. Silas is the only one to take courage and explore the deepest dark of the forest. He was sure that the disappearance of all people, including his daughter, had to do with Kron’s experiments and projects. It’s not only that he wants to make them his “test objects”, Jake also wants to destroy the country by creating creatures that follow his commands all the time.


Now it’s your time to investigate the ongoing illegal plans and rescue the missing persons. Take your flashlight and be ready to dive into “Error 2351” on April 28th, 2026.

Sounds and Music sourced from freesound.org:
